name.primary: Baked Ziti with Beef or Pork Mince

region.label: Americas
region.cuisine_label: Baked pasta in an Italian-American style

summary: Short tube pasta, part-cooked and tossed with a spiced mince and passata sauce, layered with dollops of ricotta and covered with mozzarella and parmesan, then baked under foil and uncovered to brown. Prepare the pasta and sauce on the stove, then bake until the pasta finishes cooking and the cheese browns.

ingredients.item: Small brown or white onion, finely chopped
Beef or pork mince, or half of each

ingredients.quantity: ¼ teaspoon cayenne, or ¾ teaspoon chilli flakes

ingredients.item: Dried basil, dried oregano and sugar

ingredients.note: Optional in the source. Milk allergen.
Or another melting cheese. Milk allergen.
Optional in the source. Milk allergen.

ingredients.quantity: To garnish; optional in the source.

method.instruction: Cook the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says, drain it and return it to its pot. It finishes softening in the oven.
Heat the oven to 180°C. The source does not specify fan or conventional mode. Use the middle shelf as an editorial recommendation; the source gives no shelf position.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan over high heat and cook the onion and garlic for 2 minutes, until the onion turns translucent.

Add the mince and cook, breaking it up. Use a probe thermometer to verify Health Canada's 71°C internal endpoint for ground meat; the absence of pink or red is not proof. Then stir in the fennel seeds, paprika, cayenne or chilli, onion powder, salt and pepper and cook for 2 minutes more.
Add the passata, water, basil, oregano and sugar and simmer gently for 10 minutes. Taste and adjust the seasoning.

Pour 2 cups of the sauce into the pasta pot and toss, then spread the pasta in a 23 × 33 cm baking dish. Dot the ricotta over it, pour over the rest of the sauce, and top with the mozzarella and parmesan.
Cover loosely with foil and bake for 20 minutes, then remove the foil and bake for 10 to 15 minutes more, until the cheese is melted and golden. Garnish with the herbs if using.

yield_note: Serves 6, as stated by the source. Source times: 10 minutes preparation and 1 hour cooking. The source gives no resting time or refrigerated storage duration for the baked dish. Make-ahead, per the source: cool the drained pasta (tossed in a little oil) and the sauce separately and covered, assemble up to the cheese, then refrigerate or freeze; thaw a frozen dish in the fridge for 24 hours and bake for 30 to 35 minutes, 25 covered and 10 uncovered. The make-ahead instruction is internally inconsistent: its stated 30 to 35 minutes includes stages of 25 covered + 10 uncovered, which sum to 35 minutes. Keep those stages as the planning guide and verify the measured endpoint; do not shorten them to force the lower total.

caveats: Mincing can spread surface contamination through the meat. Measure Health Canada's 71°C internal endpoint for ground meat with a probe thermometer; colour, including no remaining pink, does not validate it.
Allergens: wheat in the pasta, and milk in the ricotta, mozzarella and parmesan.

When making ahead, cool the pasta and sauce before assembling, keep the assembled dish in the fridge or freezer, and thaw a frozen one in the fridge as the source says, never on the bench. A dish baked from cold may need longer than the source’s times. Check that it is hot right through.
Leftovers: chill promptly and reheat until the centre reaches 74°C (Health Canada's figure for leftovers). The source states no fridge life for the baked dish.
